People, Space, and Statistics

Informed citizens make better policy choices; better policies save lives and resources.

A blog on econometrics, spatial statistics, remote sensing, and scientific visualization – with code samples in R, Python, JS and D3.js.

Topics range from sustainable agriculture and food security, to policies for equitable trade, growth and development, the geopolitics of natural resources.

You’ll also find book and article reviews, and the occasional shout-out and opinion pieces. Check out my full Bio for contact details.

Featured Projects

The work I deliver for public agencies is to be found in code repositories on Github. Other (restricted or confidential) projects are outlined in the portfolio section of this website.
